SELECT B.ACTIVITY_NO activityNo , B.ACTIVITY_TITLE activityTitle , B.ACTIVITY_CONTENT activityContent , B.VIEW_COUNT viewCount , B.ENROLL_DATE enrollDate , M.NICKNAME nickname , A.FILE_PATH thumbnailPath , NVL(R.REPLY_COUNT, 0) AS replyCount FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD B JOIN CL_MEMBER M ON (B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN CL_ACTIVITY_ATTACHMENT A ON B.ACTIVITY_NO = A.REF_BNO AND A.THUMBNAIL_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ACTIVITY_BOARD_NO , COUNT(*) AS REPLY_COUNT FROM CL_ACTIVITY_REPLY WHERE STATUS = 'Y' GROUP BY ACTIVITY_BOARD_NO ) R ON B.ACTIVITY_NO = R.ACTIVITY_BOARD_NO WHERE B.STATUS = 'Y'
ORDER BY B.ACTIVITY_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD B JOIN CL_MEMBER M ON (B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO) WHERE B.STATUS = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CL_ACTIVITY_ATTACHMENT ( FILE_NO , REF_BNO , ORIGIN_NAME , CHANGE_NAME , FILE_PATH , UPLOAD_DATE , THUMBNAIL_YN ) VALUES ( SEQ_ACTIVITY_FILE_NO.NEXTVAL , #{refBno} , #{originName} , #{changeName} , #{filePath} , SYSDATE , DEFAULT )
mapper.select: SELECT B.ACTIVITY_NO , B.ACTIVITY_TITLE , B.ACTIVITY_CONTENT , B.LAT , B.LNG , B.REGION_NO , C.CERTIFICATION_NO , A.FILE_PATH thumbnailPath , B.ADDRESS FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD B LEFT JOIN CL_ACTIVITY_ATTACHMENT A ON B.ACTIVITY_NO = A.REF_BNO AND A.THUMBNAIL_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN CL_ACTIVITY_CERTIFICATION C ON B.ACTIVITY_NO = C.ACTIVITY_BOARD_NO WHERE B.ACTIVITY_NO = #{id}

SELECT B.ACTIVITY_NO AS activityNo , B.ACTIVITY_TITLE AS activityTitle , B.ACTIVITY_CONTENT AS activityContent , TO_CHAR(B.ENROLL_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS enrollDate , B.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount , B.LAT AS lat , B.LNG AS lng , B.ADDRESS AS address , M.NICKNAME AS nickName , M.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo , B.REGION_NO AS regionNo , C.CERTIFICATION_NO AS certificationNo , CC2.certificationCount , CS2.carbonSave , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CL_ACTIVITY_LIKE L WHERE L.ACTIVITY_BOARD_NO = B.ACTIVITY_NO ) AS likeCount , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CL_ACTIVITY_LIKE L2 WHERE L2.ACTIVITY_BOARD_NO = B.ACTIVITY_NO AND L2.MEMBER_NO = #{loginMemberNo} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isLiked FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD B JOIN CL_MEMBER M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN CL_ACTIVITY_CERTIFICATION C ON B.ACTIVITY_NO = C.ACTIVITY_BOARD_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MEMBER_NO , COUNT(*) AS certificationCount FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'Y' GROUP BY MEMBER_NO ) CC2 ON M.MEMBER_NO = CC2.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT B3.MEMBER_NO , NVL(SUM(CC.CARBON_ACCUM), 0) AS carbonSave FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD B3 JOIN CL_ACTIVITY_CERTIFICATION C2 ON B3.ACTIVITY_NO = C2.ACTIVITY_BOARD_NO JOIN CL_ACTIVITY_CERTIFICATION_CATEGORY CC ON C2.CERTIFICATION_NO = CC.CERTIFICATION_NO WHERE B3.STATUS = 'Y' GROUP BY B3.MEMBER_NO ) CS2 ON M.MEMBER_NO = CS2.MEMBER_NO WHERE B.ACTIVITY_NO = #{activityNo} AND B.STATUS = 'Y'
SELECT FILE_PATH FROM CL_ACTIVITY_ATTACHMENT WHERE REF_BNO = #{activityNo} ORDER BY FILE_NO ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CL_ACTIVITY_LIKE ( LIKE_NO , ACTIVITY_BOARD_NO , MEMBER_NO , CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_ACTIVITY_LIKE_NO.NEXTVAL , #{activityNo} , #{memberNo} , SYSDATE )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CL_ACTIVITY_LIKE WHERE ACTIVITY_BOARD_NO = #{activityNo} AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CL_ACTIVITY_LIKE WHERE ACTIVITY_BOARD_NO = #{activityNo} AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
SELECT ACTIVITY_NO AS activityNo , MEMBER_NO AS memberNo FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD WHERE ACTIVITY_NO = #{activityNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD SET STATUS = 'N' WHERE ACTIVITY_NO = #{activityNo}
mapper.select: SELECT R.REPLY_NO AS replyNo , R.REPLY_CONTENT AS replyContent , TO_CHAR(R.ENROLL_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS enrollDate , R.ACTIVITY_BOARD_NO AS activityBoardNo , R.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo , M.NICKNAME AS writer FROM CL_ACTIVITY_REPLY R JOIN CL_MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE R.ACTIVITY_BOARD_NO = #{activityBoardNo} AND R.STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY R.REPLY_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CL_ACTIVITY_REPLY ( REPLY_NO , REPLY_CONTENT , ENROLL_DATE , STATUS , ACTIVITY_BOARD_NO , MEMBER_NO ) VALUES ( SEQ_ACTIVITY_REPLY_NO.NEXTVAL , #{replyContent} , SYSDATE , 'Y' , #{activityBoardNo} , #{memberNo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CL_ACTIVITY_REPLY SET STATUS = 'N' WHERE REPLY_NO = #{replyNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CL_ACTIVITY_REPLY WHERE ACTIVITY_BOARD_NO = #{activityNo} AND STATUS = 'Y'
SELECT MEMBER_NO FROM CL_ACTIVITY_REPLY WHERE REPLY_NO = #{replyNo} AND STATUS = 'Y'
